evidence.reason: The exit adapter no longer rejects a null review stream with 'missing classified artifact'; it forwards an empty stream so completeLocalReview runs, writes the no-verdict receipt, records the failed attempt and releases the run, plus a regression test covering the missing-review.ndjson case.
